lines.en: I run two steps, hop, and run again.
I dart low across the ground.
I use my tail to hold the sharp turns.
I round a stone without slowing.

lines.zh: 我爪子抓地，一下就冲出去。
lines.en: My claws bite the dirt and I shoot forward.

lines.zh: 我回头看一眼，又往前跑。
lines.en: I glance back, then run on.
I leap a ditch.
I run fast and can't stop.

lines.zh: 我贴着草丛跑，草都在动。
lines.en: I run along the grass, and it ripples.

lines.zh: 我朝那边跑了几步，转回来。
lines.en: I run a few steps that way and turn back.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在地上留下三个点。
lines.en: My toes leave three dots in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我跑过的地方，土都翻了。
lines.en: The soil turns where I run.

lines.zh: 我跳上一块石头，又跳下去。
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and down again.
Mid-run, I stop dead.
I stand there, tail twitching.
My head keeps turning.
I lift a foot and set it down, restless.
A blade of grass stirs, and my head snaps toward it.
I bare my small teeth to the wind.
I lift a claw to lick it.
I tilt my head at a bird.
I want to run, but there's no direction.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，土从背上落下。
lines.en: I shake and dirt slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很快，一直很快。
lines.en: My breathing is quick, always quick.
I scratch the dirt with a hind foot.
I smell chicken.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个地方看很久。
lines.en: I stare at one spot a long time.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，天上没有东西。
lines.en: I look up; nothing in the sky.
You stand still, so I watch.
Do you have meat?
I tilt my head, sizing your height.

lines.zh: 你站起来比我高一大截。
lines.en: Standing, you're a good head taller.
I take two steps toward you and back off.
Your boots look like they'd jar my teeth.
I'm not afraid; I'm curious.
You move once; I move three times.
I open my mouth without a sound.

lines.zh: 这味道我在林子里没闻过。
lines.en: I've not smelled this in the wood before.
I trot half a circle around you.

lines.zh: 你矮下去，我的胆子就大。
lines.en: When you lower yourself, my courage grows.
I spring away but get grazed.
I tumble and get up.
I back off and shake myself.
My steps fall out of rhythm for a beat.
I yelp once, quick.
There's a split in my scales.
I run half a circle low.
I pant twice and keep running.
I lick the beads of blood off my claws.
I still move fast; don't worry.
That's chicken!
That — toss it here.
I leap for it and miss by inches.
That smell won't let me stop.
Throw the meat, and I'll chase it.
I circle you, sniffing this way and that.
I open my mouth for you to let go.
Just one bite, truly.
That smell sets my tail wagging.
I push toward your hand.
You touch me, and I spring away.
That sends me rolling twice.
I shoot between your legs.
I hit your knee; it hurts.
I slip and hit a stone.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖被你踩得发麻。
lines.en: You step on my tail tip until it goes numb.
We collide, and I bolt.
I leap over your shoulder.
I hug your side and circle halfway.
After the bump I run back to look at you.

lines.zh: 另一只在草里跑得很快。
lines.en: Another runs fast in the grass.
She's just a little faster than I am.
We circle each other, fast.
Her tail is slimmer.
We chase a bug together.
She rubs her head on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们一起晒太阳，动个不停。
lines.en: We sun ourselves, never still.
She jumps higher than I do.
We run side by side a while.
Before dark, we're still running.
I snatch a piece of meat and run.
I carry off the feather you dropped.
I grab a bone, quickly.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚蛋，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up an egg and hold it in my mouth.
I drag off your glove.
I pick up a bug and eat it.

lines.zh: 我叼起一小块布，甩了甩。
lines.en: I take a scrap of cloth and shake it.
I carry off the fallen fruit.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根细枝，咬着玩。
lines.en: I pick up a twig and chew it.

lines.zh: 我把你的箭头叼到草里。
lines.en: I carry your arrowhead into the grass.
There's a chicken over there.
I saw it move.
I lower my head, ready to charge.
Any closer and one leap does it.
My feet scratch the dirt.
It's smaller than me; perfect.
Locked on; no changing.
Those two legs of its can't outrun me.

lines.zh: 我兜个圈子抄它的后路。
lines.en: I loop around to cut off its rear.

lines.zh: 它的心跳声我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I can hear its heartbeat clear as day.
I'm off at a dead run.
It hasn't spotted me; good.
My tail pulls into a straight line.
It backs to the wall—just what I wanted.
I follow it, left and right.
It turns; I turn sharper.
I leap over the stone.
I snap at its tail and miss.
It's panting; I'm not.
I hug its flank and seal off the way.
I loop ahead and wait.
It hops a wall; I follow.
I keep quiet and simply quicken my step.
A little closer and I pounce.
Its feet are slipping.
I keep low and fast.
It paused; now.

lines.zh: 我听着它喘得没了节奏。
lines.en: I listen as its panting loses its rhythm.
I circled halfway and cut it off.
I spring, clawtips leading.
I bite its wing.
My toes dig into its back.
I leap and bite from above.
My teeth are small, but quick.
I clamp down and shake it twice.
It breaks free; I pounce again.
This bite lands on its neck.
I lash my tail at its leg.
I land, turn, and charge again.
It backs off; I run circles.
I stand on its feathers.
I threw my whole body into it.
It goes down; I spring back half a pace.

lines.zh: 蛋被扔出去，我在草里出来。
lines.en: The egg was thrown, and I hatched in the grass.
The first thing I do is run.
The slime brought me back here.
I shake off the shell.

lines.zh: 我蹿出草丛，草比我还高。
lines.en: I burst from grass taller than I am.
I hear birds nearby.
I stand, my legs strong.
I run a circle and come back.

lines.zh: 这里的味道多得让我发晕。
lines.en: There are so many scents here I feel dizzy.
I look up; the sun is right.
First I'll find a vantage point.
My claws are already itching.
The moment I land, I start moving.
Something moved; I'll look.
I hop a low wall.
It's much better than the egg.
I start running, for no reason.
My tail lands first.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的尾巴，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Fire catches my tail; I shake it.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall from a height and roll twice.

lines.zh: 我呛了一口水，四爪乱蹬。
lines.en: I choke on a mouthful of water, all four claws flailing.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出去，落地就跑。
lines.en: The blast throws me; I land running.
An arrow grazes my hind leg.
A light locks my legs.
Hunger makes my legs tremble.
A flash of lightning blinds me.

lines.zh: 这里没地可跑，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There's no ground to run on; I keep falling.
